'''Tomas Klco''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[September 2000 Vancouver tournament (2 September)]] on 2 September 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind what you have learned]], according to Ryan Mathison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1206">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-06-vancouver-bc-canada-9-2-00d1206/ vancouver-bc-canada-9-2-00], DeckTech (Ryan "Cradossk" Mathison, 6 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-06-vancouver-bc-canada-9-2-00d1206/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
